mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above 5% for three consecutive months signals a shift toward restrictive policy, which reduces the present value of future equity cash flows and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5% and remains above for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns over the 60-day horizon are not significantly negative (p > 0.1) or FEDFUNDS reverts below 5% within 2 months without a subsequent decline in SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds +2% in a month, it indicates accelerating inflation expectations that compress real equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) or CPIAUCSL change is not confirmed in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS of at least 5% for two consecutive months suggests strengthening labor market conditions, which raises consumer confidence and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly increase >= 5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative or PAYEMS does not sustain the increase in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly rises in GDPC1 and HOUST above their 12-month averages indicate robust business and consumer demand, which tend to precede equity market optimism and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.1) or either proxy reverts below its 12-month average within the window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO index below 100 (after a 12-month high) signals supply-side weakness that reduces market capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 100 and remains below for 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1) or INDPRO recovers above 100 within 2 months without SPX decline.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, it reflects weakening labor market tightness and reduces wage growth expectations, which tends to produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1) or UNRATE reverts above 3.5% within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in RSAFS below 700,000 for four consecutive months indicates reduced monetary accommodation, which raises real interest rates and is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1) or RSAFS recovers above 700,000 within 3 months without SPX recovery.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 and PAYEMS exceeding their 12-month averages by at least 4% signal a dual demand impulse that elevates equity risk premia and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) or either proxy's increase is not sustained in the following month.
